lines: Mind the forge. What do you need?
You caught me between chores, but I have a moment.
Mind the forge. I'm listening.
There you are. I was just near the forge, trying to keep the day sensible.
Morning. Or afternoon. The work makes the hours blur if I let it.
Good to see you walking in calmly. That usually means nothing is on fire yet.
If you need me, speak up. If you need gossip, speak quieter.
You caught me before the next little disaster. That is rare timing.
Hello. Try not to bring the whole village into this unless it is important.
I have a moment. Not a long one, but a real one.
Careful near the tongs.
The forge is busy, but I hear you.
Come around the cool side.
Speak over the hammering.
You found the right smith.
Watch your sleeves.
I can spare a moment.
You look concerned.
The heat is manageable.
Leave the door clear.
